signature: A rooted directed acyclic multigraph with a distinguished source and a set of sink terminals, where each terminal has exactly two directed source-to-terminal paths and the path family is closed, equal to the entire set of realizable paths. The incidence pattern is such that two paths for a terminal share only a common prefix from the source and are forbidden from merging back together after they split. Local regularity conditions on the path family force a global rigidity result: the graph collapses to an out-arborescence rooted at the source in which the only vertices of in-degree greater than one are the terminals, each of in-degree exactly two. This is a representation theorem.
